label: hud_net_status_online_message00
text: You will now connect to the internet. Your game\nwill be saved. Is that OK?

label: hud_net_status_online_message04
text: You’re now connected to the internet.

label: hud_net_status_offline_message01
text: You will be disconnected from the internet.\nWould you like to continue?

label: hud_net_penalty_message00
text:
You failed to disconnect properly when you last
played online.\c
Disconnecting in the middle of online play can
inconvenience other Trainers playing with you.\c
If you repeatedly disconnect in the middle of
online play, you’ll be blocked from online play
for a time, so please check that you have a good
and stable internet connection before playing.

label: hud_net_penalty_message01
text:
You failed to disconnect properly when you last
played online.\c
You will not be able to try connecting again until
[VAR 0x0201(0000)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0000,0604)] hass have elapsed.\c
Please check that you have a stable internet
connection, then try again in [VAR 0x0201(0000)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0000,0100)]s.\c
